localBiteReport: The inshore bite around Destin and Choctawhatchee Bay is reportedly one of the best of the year right now, according to a report dated September 18–24, 2026 featuring Capt. Adam Schroeder of Ignite The Bite Charters out of Destin. Bait has become abundant and easy to find early in the morning, and redfish, flounder, and trout are all responding well to it. Both bull reds and slot redfish are active, with the outgoing tide around the bridges being a particularly productive window — larger redfish are responding to live croakers and spot minnows around bridge structure. Water temperature at this location is currently 86°F, which is keeping fish on a summer-style pattern of early-morning and late-afternoon activity on the flats, with fish moving to deeper structure mid-day.
